name: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth (Total Conversion)
author: Experimental Showcase
description: An experimental proof of concept and showcase of custom mechanics and total conversions in PokeBonk. Replaces core game assets, UI, and event themes with The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth while remaining a togglable mod (overrides other active mods except Hyrule's Collection). Features: 55 playable characters and bosses, 45 custom enemies, 8 multi-room Isaac chapters with locked doors, bombs, secret rooms, and void pits, Isaac-themed Expedition/Tower/Boss Rush maps, 40 custom items, 61 custom attacks, 71 synergies, 38 interactive map mechanics, an Isaac HUD with hearts and a fog-of-war minimap, 63 custom 3D models, 20 music tracks, and 114 sound effects.

en.\u00a1Temporada 3! Llega Johto: la segun: Season 3! Johto arrives: the second generation, four maps, Rifts and Trinkets.
en.**\u00a1Llega Johto!** Los 100 Pok\u00e9: **Johto is here!** All 100 second-generation Fighter appear in the world and **59 join the Basement Cast**, each with their own kit, Ultimate and synergy.
en.**Incienso, Grietas y Reliquias**: abre: **Incense, Rifts and Trinkets**: open a Rift with the C key, defeat its Alpha and choose from **32 equippable Trinkets**.
en.**Piedra Eterna** en la Tienda: tu Pok\u: **Everstone** in the Shop: your Fighter can stay unevolved and still grow.

en.**Dos Mutaciones del d\u00eda de Johto**: **Two Johto Daily Mutations**: **Day and Night** and **Pokérus**, on Nightmare and with prizes **only earned with a Johto Fighter**.
en.**Unir ataques** en la M\u00e1quina de B: **Join moves** at Synergy Pedestal: put two moves in one slot; they stay the same and gain a random bonus.
en.**El cooperativo da premios de temporada: **Co-op now gives season prizes**: the top 10 of each team board win a badge, Soul Shards and exclusive **frames, avatars, a background and titles**.
en.**Cooperativo a la altura de Johto**: ev: **Co-op ready for Johto**: map events at the same time for everyone, shared new bosses and **Team Rifts** where everyone picks a Trinket.
en.**Las fusiones pegan mucho m\u00e1s**: r: **Synergies hit much harder**: fresh ones already double the damage of their two moves and keep their types and class.

en.**La Gran Expedici\u00f3n**: una extracc: **The Greedier Expedition**: an extraction with lots of loot no longer ends as a fall; you keep it all, including your secure pocket.
en.Las **fusiones** se lanzan tambi\u00e9n: **Synergies** now also cast in high-area builds, where they were left unused.
en.La **ficha de entrenador** vuelve a abri: The **explorer card** opens again for players with Greedier Expedition runs.
en.Las descripciones de las **Reliquias** s: **Trinket** descriptions are readable in dark mode.

en.Las **fusiones de firma** de **Sunflora,: The **signature synergies** of **Sunflora, Ursaring, Shuckle and Lugia** can now be made.

customLevels.name: The Basement (Chapter I)
